description: This file defines utility enums for environment variable handling and path management within an OpenClaw project, including functions to retrieve configuration paths, state directories, and workspace URLs.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable's value as a trimmed string, or nil if not set or empty.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Computes the URL for the state directory, either from environment variable overrides or defaults to '~/.openclaw'.

methods.name: resolveConfigCandidate
methods.description: Checks for the existence of 'openclaw.json' in a given directory and returns its URL if found.

methods.name: configURL
methods.description: Determines the configuration file's URL, using environment override or defaulting to a path within the state directory.

methods.name: workspaceURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the workspace directory within the state directory.
